wide.description: iPad hosting the exact open-Duo geometry fixture

context: Run ios/scripts/verify.sh with a compact Duo UUID and a wide iPad UUID before installing on the phone.
List ALL available simulators, not only booted devices. Verify deviceTypeIdentifier and iOS runtime; a device name is not proof.
Direct xcodebuild simulator tests default to compact. Set CX_IOS_SIMULATOR_PROFILE=wide only for the wide fixture tests.
Keep fiction-only fixtures and the exact-width open-Duo harness. A test runner that fails at setup verified nothing.
